signers.label: Judiciary
signers.note: Filled automatically at approval — not part of the intake handoff flow.

fields.label: Party One
fields.prompt: What is Party One's full name?

fields.label: Party One CID
fields.prompt: What is Party One's CID? If this is you, run /cid in city — it copies your CID to your clipboard, paste it here. If you don't have it, answer "Unknown".

fields.label: Party Two
fields.prompt: What is Party Two's full name?

fields.label: Party Two CID
fields.prompt: What is Party Two's CID? If this is you, run /cid in city — it copies your CID to your clipboard, paste it here. If you don't have it, answer "Unknown".

fields.label: Officiant CID
fields.prompt: What is the officiant's CID? If this is you, run /cid in city — it copies your CID to your clipboard, paste it here. If you don't have it, answer "Unknown".

fields.label: Name Change on Marriage
fields.prompt: Would either party like to change their name as part of this marriage? If so, say who and what name they're taking (or answer "None") — this can be bundled into the marriage filing instead of a separate name change request.

fields.label: Witness CID
fields.prompt: What is the witness's CID? If this is you, run /cid in city — it copies your CID to your clipboard, paste it here. If you don't have it, answer "Unknown".

fields.label: Party One's Signature
fields.note: Collected from Party One directly. Filled via the separate document hand-off/signature-routing system after the filer submits -- not asked during intake.

fields.label: Party Two's Signature
fields.note: Collected from Party Two directly. Filled via the separate document hand-off/signature-routing system after the filer submits -- not asked during intake.

fields.label: Officiant Signature
fields.note: Collected from the officiant directly. Filled via the separate document hand-off/signature-routing system after the filer submits -- not asked during intake.

fields.label: Judiciary
fields.note: The reviewing/approving Judiciary of record — distinct from the Officiant. Filled in by the bot, never asked of the applicants.
